criteria.name: 2 availableAt: a cap block is available at the next local midnight or at the end of quiet hours that follows it, a quiet-hours block at the end of quiet hours, consent and delivered entries carry none
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 4 dryRun: counts the proposed policy on last week's events, and leaves the live counters untouched
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 5 equality: dryRun with the live policy matches the live outcomes of the same events, and repeats identically
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.name: 6 durability: the log written by one process is read by later processes, and 24 concurrent decisions over two processes log 24 entries with exactly 3 delivered
criteria.label: outcome
